item.text:
The audit now has 25 confirmed findings. This pass added a storage data-loss defect:

- **A failed `append_on_prefix` permanently deletes the old suffix.** The persistent backend executes the range deletion immediately, updates `next_log_key`, and only then serializes replacement entries. With an existing `[1,2,3,4]` log, a replacement containing one valid and one serialization-failing entry returned `Err`; after reopening RocksDB, the log was only `[1,2,3]`. Both original entry 4 and the valid replacement were lost: [append_on_prefix_error.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/persistent_check/src/bin/append_on_prefix_error.rs).

The snapshot-aware crash harness also reproduced the delta-snapshot defect at step 50, finding value `1` recorded as decided at index 0 while another node’s snapshot contained value `5`.

Full findings, affected code, conditions, commands, and retained logs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
